title: Calendar
description: A month grid to pick one day or a range (YYYY-MM-DD, weeks start on Monday). DatePicker shows it in a popover; place it inline for schedules and report filters.
when: Inline date selection on a page; picking a date range for a report.

instead.need: A date field in a form

a11y: role="grid": arrows move by day / week, Home / End to the week's ends, PageUp / PageDown by month (Shift: year), Enter / Space pick; today has aria-current="date".

examples.title: Range
examples.description: Click a start day, then an end day.
